title: Implement @sevenpico/cdk-construct-lambda-function
description:
Port terraform-aws-lambda. Implement a Lambda Function construct with context-based naming and tagging. Read spec/construct-lambda-function.md and the source Terraform module linked in the spec. GitHub issue #9.

Workflow:
1. Resource Specialist implements: pure functions in {name}-fns.ts, thin Construct class in {name}.ts, BDD tests, package README.
2. Code Reviewer signs off: JSII compliance (no union/function types, all props readonly, full re-exports), functional architecture split (no side-effects in fns.ts, no logic in construct), spec fidelity (props match Terraform vars, defaults match Terraform defaults, contextId/contextTags/isEnabled used correctly), README accuracy.
3. QA Engineer signs off: BDD scenarios cover all spec scenarios including enabled:false early-exit, pure function tests cover defaults/overrides/edge cases, CDK assertions are meaningful and would catch a broken implementation.

Task is done only when all three phases are complete.

history.comment: Updated description to reflect full review workflow
